positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Software Infrastructure, Software Design and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain analytics for 400+ person organization
   o	Reduced twice-daily memory usage of legacy queries from 800-950 GB to 1.2 GB
   o	Reduced average server time for data ETL flows from combined 3+ hours to less than 30 minutes   
   o	Eliminated developer time by automating flow for a net savings of $21k annually
   o	Integrated and augmented enterprise-wide data warehousing efforts

Lead team responsible for Business Tools and DevSecOps as Product Owner
   o	Instituted version control and CI/CD pipelines for existing applications
   o	Cross-trained 6 business-critical projects with solo developers among a team of 4 to prevent single points of failure
   o	Lead and mentor cross-functional group of 6 citizen developers in separate organizations in development within Ignition to empower non-software teams to own continuous improvement

Perform and administer Agile development and project management
   o	Scrum, Kanban, and Scaled Agile Framework formats
   o	Manage scope, schedule, and budget of team and product backlog

Support standardization of Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement applications across business areas

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Software Industry and +9 skills

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Designs and implements Process Optimization solutions:
- Develops and maintains MES for facility operations
- Configures alerts and escalation routes on facility status, incident reporting, and other metrics
- Designs and implements business intelligence reports and dashboards
- Maintains data collection and analysis tools, both manual and automatic
- Integrates various, disparate business systems and tools into Smart Factory implementation
- Consults on development of business intelligence metrics for cross-site usage and consistency

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
- Administered assessments to evaluate students' progress and areas of need in math
- Tutored in homework assignments as well as proprietary Mathnasium curriculum
- Tutored students from 1st grade through Calculus II
- Student to Instructor ratio of 4:1

positions.title: Center Director
positions.description:
- Handles day-to-day tasks of center in conjunction with Assistant Director
- Maintains communication with guardians of past and present students
- Holds demonstrations and consultations with potential clients in order to enroll students
- Trains staff, including instructors and assistant directors, to ensure quality of instruction and efficiency of operation.

positions.title: Assistant Director Of Education
positions.description:
- Lead Instructor
- Assured quality of education through training of instructors
- Managed day-to-day tasks of Center
- Designed processes to make task management more efficient
- Handled customer relations through phone and email communication
- Moderated online learning platform
